12.t: Working with data: the blubber glove
q: What was the temperature in the empty glove after 5 minutes?
Calculate the temperature drop in the blubber glove over 5 minutes.
The empty glove cooled much faster (28 °C drop vs 8 °C).
Explain the results and link them to a polar bear.
Fat is a poor conductor: it is insulation that slows heat loss to the water; polar bears have up to 11 cm of blubber.
